manifest.name: Succinea
manifest.author: Shellex
manifest.description: A delicate status bar for time, Shellex version, W3 desktop switching, runtime memory and vault storage.

files.README.md:
# Succinea

Succinea is a small host status bar app. Right-click it to edit visible status modules. When W3 desktops are enabled, Succinea can show compact desktop buttons so the user can switch desktop by clicking 1, 2, 3 or 4.

Run `succinea help` in Shell for usage.

Configuration lives at `/system/succinea/config.json` inside the vault.
files.config.example.json:
{
  "label": "Succinea",
  "showDateTime": true,
  "showVersion": true,
  "showDesktops": true,
  "showMemory": true,
  "showStorage": true,
  "showRunningApps": true,
  "compact": true
}
